activity.title: Last week, I wrapped up my summer internship with Fidelity Investments in the Century City Investor Center, and I'm incredibly grateful for everything I learned over the past 10 weeks. This summer, I had the unique opportunity to interact with more than 200 clients and shadow advisors across the branch. Through these experiences, I strengthened the skills needed to earn trust and provide support for a wide variety of client needs. Watching families leave conversations with greater confidence and a clear path forward reinforced my passion for helping others achieve their financial goals. The biggest highlight of my summer was leading a project that helped connect more clients with Fidelity’s educational resources. I developed a solution that was adopted by the entire team, leading to better client outcomes. As a result of the project’s outcomes, I had the opportunity to present my work to Fidelity’s Los Angeles Central leadership, including Market Leader Stephen Jennings, CFP® , and branch leaders across the market. I’m especially proud to see the process I created expand beyond the Century City branch and continue making an impact after my internship. A special thank you to my branch leaders, Paulina Andrade and Richard Lee , for challenging me to grow, trusting me with meaningful opportunities, and supporting me every step of the way. Finally, I’d like to thank the entire Century City team for making this summer such a great experience. I’m grateful for the opportunity to have been part of such an amazing team! #Fidtern #FidelityAssociate ...more ...more

Gemini now has 1B+ monthly users and is Google’s fastest-growing product ever. It is the 14th Google product to cross 1B users 🎉 The Gemini team shared some stats: 🗣️ 63% of users talk to Gemini out loud 🤝 One in five Gemini Live interactions go beyond voice, and use camera or screen share. 📷 Gemini generates more than 150 million photos every day. 🍎 More than 100 million people use Gemini on iOS, and MacOS users prompt around twice as much as people using other surfaces. ...more ...more

This summer, I took on the project of being one of six “Intern Champions” for our 150 San Francisco Google interns. As Intern Champions, we were in charge of creating a sense of community, planning social events, and providing career advice. Some of the events we planned included a SF Giants baseball game night, a mini-golf social, and a boba & snacks social. I remember being in their shoes just a couple of years ago as an intern trying to take advantage of the opportunity given, and graduating college three years ago with all the challenges that came with it. My favorite part of being a part of this was those one-on-one conversations, giving advice on making the most out of the opportunity, sharing post-college guidance, or just offering general life advice like navigating being away from home. To all the interns I had the privilege of meeting, I hope I was able to play a small part in making this summer just a little bit more special. ...more ...more

Hey friends, it’s Athena! :-) For the past 1,000+ days at UCLA, I’ve mostly been a passive consumer on LinkedIn. Watching the people around me grow and unlock opportunities they never imagined has been incredibly inspiring. I had always been afraid to post because it felt “cringy,” and being a LinkedIn warrior was kind of “taboo.” But yesterday morning, Khang put on the "Invest Like the Best" podcast featuring Joshua Kushner, the founder of Thrive Capital, and he said: “You only have 1 life… you shouldn't care about what other people think because, at the end of the day, it's only about ***what you think about yourself.***” This quote stuck with me the whole day as I ate, talked to my friends, and drove home, so I decided to make this first post. I hope you follow me on this journey as I share my professional and personal growth stories, along with all the thoughts in my brain. My next post is coming tomorrow. It’ll be about moving to SF for the first time. Shoutout to Lu for pushing me to make this post 🐶 🐶 - AL ...more ...more
